buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 5. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NA Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: ED/OFDC or his authorized representative 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The Custom Bid is floated as Open Tender Enquiry (OTE) through GeM Portal for “SURFACE TREATMENT OF MS BLADE (AS PER SCOPE OF WORK NO. : 09/MF/SOW/S. T. MS. B/030/25-26 DATED: 08/01/2026).” for qty. 200000 Nos. Bid Distribution Criteria: L1:L2:L3 :: 50%:30%:20% at L1 rate Reverse Auction: Applicable with H1 elimination. Option Clause: 25% Applicable EMD: Rs. 105138.00/- or bid security declaration PSD: 5% Applicable (If S.O. value is above Rs. 10 Lakhs) Inspection Authority: ED/OFDC or his authorized representative Inspection Type: Inspection at Buyer’s premises Documents required from Firm: GST, MSME, Udyam Aadhaar etc. Delivery Period: 150 Days Delivery Schedule: Firm to supply minimum 10000 Nos. weekly. Additional Terms & Conditions: 1) Firm must have to submit advance sample before bulk supply. 2) Firm shall collect the material against Bank Guarantee. 3) Firm must carefully handle the material during transit from OFDC to Firm’s Premises at their own arrangement including expenditure if any. 4) Delivery Schedule :- Firm should be capable of supplying minimum 10000 Nos. per week. 5) In case firm does not uphold its supply commitments of min. 10000 Nos. per week for consecutive 03 weeks, OFDC reserves the right to reduce S.O. qty./ cancel S.O. 6) In case of Rectifiable defects, observed during QC inspection of bulk supply as per schedule, the defective qty to be repaired within 04 working days. 7) In case of Irreparable/non-rectified defects, the amount of raw materials cost to be recovered/deducted from pending bills / Bank Guarantee and defective components will be at OFDC and shall not be returned to firm to avoid mixing in future consignments. 8) OFDC shall have right to carry out chemical / any other relevant test to ensure that materials issued by OFDC is being utilized for manufacture of critical component. The decision of OFDC shall be final in this regard. 9) Firm should liaise with user section for drawal of raw material and maintaining the requisite quality.

10) In case of delay in staggered supply of the first and consecutive lots, OFDC may impose LD or cancel the S.O. as per decision of competent authority. 11) OFDC reserves the right to issue the material as per performance of the firm. 12) Firm should submit Bank Guarantee for minimum 10000 Nos. 13) Firm shall visit OFDC premises to see the job before participating in Tender as mention in Scope of Work. Local Workshop Clause: Bidder should have facility within nearby areas i.e. North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas, Kolkata, Hoogly, Nadia, Howrah, Midnapore (East & West) districts of West Bengal. Firms will have to submit Factory License as a supporting document of their location. In absence of Factory License, address mentioned in Udyam/Registration Certificate will be considered. The subject item is a Job Work with OFDC material which requires strict monitoring. Firm must have local factory established in side Kolkata and nearby area. Past Performance Criteria: 1) Firm must comply to Scope of Work No. 09/MF/SOW/S.T.MS.B/030/25-26. 2) Firm should submit previous supply order copy for last 5 year of similar type of Surface Treatment item. 3) Firm should have past experience of supply similar item of Surface Treatment to any Govt. / DPSU / Public Listed Company of value minimum Rs. 15 Lakhs. (cumulative). 4) Firm has to submit complete Plant and Machinery list. 5) Firm must be OEM or submit Tie Up facility with complete plant & machinery details required to complete the subject job dully signed and stumped on company letter head. Other Terms & Conditions: 1) Firm should submit undertaking along with bid for acceptance of above delivery schedule otherwise bidder may be disqualified at the time of TEC. 2) OFDC have right to visit or surprise check at bidders premises during pre contract as well as post contract. 3) Bulk quantity to be supplied at OFDC premises and bulk to be inspected at OFDC. 4) As per YILSPM’2024. Bank Guarantee Format for PBG and EMD is uploaded herewith. For any inquiry please contact Sri Akash Verma, Deputy General Manager, for Executive Director, OFDC, Phn. No. 033-2569-4012.
Bidder may also email at OFDC email Id: mmofdc@ord.gov.in . 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
